title: UN DESA FINS Digital Platform
shortDescription: Architected, built, and maintained the Financing for Small Island Developing States (FINS) digital platform on Drupal 10, structuring interactive video galleries, policy repositories, and financing toolkits.
mandateChallenge: Legacy UN web pages buried critical training videos and development financing tools under fragmented navigation, hurting retention among government ministry delegates and global finance partners.
executionCraft: Built custom Drupal 10 content architectures, responsive HTML/CSS/JS component layouts, and structured video learning hubs accompanied by Google Analytics telemetry.
impactMetric: +45% Monthly User Engagement Lift on Drupal 10
